records.deadline_display: Your admissions application must be submitted by the funding deadline specific to your course. The funding deadline is not the same as the application deadline.

source.publisher: Cambridge Commonwealth, European & International Trust (The Cambridge Trust)
source.as_of: Trust guidance live at retrieval; the Trust's Find a scholarship page describes the current round as courses starting in the academic year 2027/28
source.raw_extract:
Meeting the deadline

Your admissions application must be submitted by the **funding deadline** specific to your course. The funding deadline is not the same as the application deadline.

If you do not know what the funding deadline is for your course, you can visit the postgraduate course directory and check your subject (the funding deadline is a drop-down section on the right-hand side of the individual course page).

Step 5: The awards process

The Trust's awarding period runs from the middle of February to the end of July and is an ongoing process throughout that period. Most of our awards are made early during the months of February and March, but some of our partner funded awards involve additional processes such as interviews, which means funding decisions tend to be later from April to June.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Your admissions application must be submitted by the funding deadline specific to your course. The funding deadline is not the same as the application deadline.
source.notes: The Trust publishes no single Trust-wide application deadline: the deadline is the course-specific funding deadline listed on each individual course page in the University of Cambridge postgraduate course directory, which is a different deadline per course. The only recurring Trust-wide timing stated is the awarding period (mid-February to end of July), which is a decision process, not an application deadline. The page does not use the word 'rolling' and does not give a fixed current date, so per the brief neither ROLLING nor ANNUAL can be asserted for an application deadline; no date was invented. Confidence HIGH refers to the finding that no single date exists, not to a date value.

GREAT Scholarships

Applications for The University of Manchester's GREAT scholarships will open to relevant offer-holders from December 2025. A scholarship application form will be emailed to all relevant offer-holders by the International Office.

Applications will close on 23 April 2026.

What are the key dates I need to be aware of?

Scholarships can only be awarded to applicants who have:

- received a conditional or unconditional offer to study at The University of Manchester by 23 April 2026;
- submitted a scholarship application form by 23 April 2026.

The scholarship application form will be emailed to all relevant offer-holders by the International Office.

Successful applicants will be notified by 29 May 2026.

source.raw_extract:
Elite Ph.D. Scholarship

The scholarship is awarded based on recommendations from the college and a review by the scholarship committee, not through the application submitted by the students.

Who is Eligible
New Ph.D. students with outstanding grades and who have no received scholarships or grants from the Taiwan government

Scholarship Content and Duration
Monthly stipends NT$ 33,000 and the tuition waiver for 2 years

Important Notes
- Scholarship recipients are required to submit their transcripts and tuition payment receipts for each semester before the specified deadline to be eligible for the scholarship in the following semester.
- Recipients will receive the scholarship on the 10th of each month, except for January and the start of each semester (September).

records.title: TU Wien Scholarships for International Students
records.deadline_display: Applications for Study Grants can usually be sent in between September and December for the wintersemester and between February and May for the summersemester.

source.as_of: live page at retrieval 2026-10-05; no cycle or year stated for the umbrella listing
source.raw_extract:
Financial Support For Students

Which grants and scholarships are available for students at TU Wien?

This website provides an overview of existing financial support.

Study Grant

Applications for Study Grants can usually be sent in between September and December for the wintersemester and between February and May for the summersemester. Please refer to the current deadlines on the website of the Study Grant Authority!

Grants for Students Coming from Abroad

Grants for Students Coming from Abroad to study at TU Wien can be found on the OeAD's GRANTS website.

Foundation Grants

The TU Wien awards Foundation Grants to students with social need. The complete application must be sent by e-mail to stiftungs-stipendium@tuwien.ac.at usually until February.

Helmut Veith Stipend

... are invited to apply in November for the annually awarded Helmut Veith Stipend.

Graduation Scholarship for Working Students

The application must be sent with all the required documents by e-mail to abschluss-stipendium@tuwien.ac.at between October and November. Please refer to the corresponding TU website for the current deadline.
source.exact_deadline_wording: This website provides an overview of existing financial support.
source.notes: This record is an umbrella entry covering several distinct TU Wien awards. The live official page gives a different timing for each award (Study Grant Sept-Dec / Feb-May; Foundation Grants usually until February; Graduation Scholarship between October and November; Helmut Veith Stipend apply in November) and defers to faculty pages and the Admission Office for current deadlines. Per the brief, different programmes at the same institution having different deadlines is not a conflict and none of these windows may be borrowed as the deadline for this umbrella record, so no single value can be written. The record's own official_source_url (https://www.tuwien.at/en/studies/scholarships) returned HTTP 404; the live equivalent page was located via TU Wien's own site navigation.
